data_facts_with_para.paragraph: Food is another area where budget varies widely. Street food stalls offer delicious options for less than $5, while dining in restaurants could cost around $10-$15 per meal. Many travelers enjoy a mix of both; for a day, you may spend around $20 for meals if you favor local eateries.
